qa.what_happened: During the sixth day of the study, I complied with all the rules as instructed. However, I noticed an increased frequency of verbal warnings from the coordinators, particularly aimed at Resident 6957. The warnings emphasized the importance of compliance for everyone's safety and well-being, which began to weigh heavily on me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was trying to maintain compliance but the constant reminders started to affect my mental state.

qa.what_happened: I complied with the rules throughout the day, but the constant warnings and emphasis on compliance began to wear on me. The lead researcher explained that the study had been stopped early because of my repeated warnings and that my participation may be reconsidered.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, but in the context of the study, I was referred to by my ID number and was under strict instructions to remain silent during quiet hours.

qa.what_happened: Today, the study was unexpectedly stopped early. I complied with all the rules, as usual, and I felt both relieved and exhausted from the ongoing stress of the study. The coordinators kept warning Resident 6957 about his breaches, which added to the tension and made the day particularly draining.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I stuck to the rules despite the pressure.
